Calculate Extension

Enter the player's positional rank per CBS H2H Points consensus rankings and FantasyPros Dynasty rankings, using the highest rank for the player across the two sites. For example, if Frank Thomas is ranked as the 2nd best 1B in the league on CBS H2H Points consensus rankings and the 4th best 1B in the league on FantasyPros Dynasty rankings, you enter the ranking of 4.

Floor rule: If the calculator value comes out lower than the player's current salary, their extension is instead 115% of their current salary (i.e. current + 15%).

Pick a position and enter a rank to see the recommended extension value.

Rising Phoenix Baseball • Methodology: extension value = average salary of ranks N−3 through N+3 at the selected position; qualifying offer = average of the top 120 salaries leaguewide. Shohei Ohtani is excluded from the UT and SP extension pools due to his dual UT/SP eligibility, but is included in the qualifying offer calculation.
